title: Phủ Cam Cathedral
axis: Positive Z faces north-northwest along the hill approach. Positive X follows the entrance toward west-southwest.
source: Historic parish dimensions and the mapped Phước Quả hill approach

mappedIdentity.name: Phủ Cam Cathedral
mappedIdentity.address: Historic Catholic cathedral site at Phước Quả hill, Huế, Vietnam

features.role: Reconstructed historic masonry envelope from documented dimensions and frontal postcard.

identityStatus: The parish history gives the nominal length, width, north entrance and twin towers. Modern mapped approach and the hilltop tie locate the historical envelope approximately at the same site.

terrainContact.basis: Original Copernicus GLO-30 at the approximate former entrance. The front stair lowers toward the north approach, and footings extend to the approximate slope.

notes: The Dieulefils postcard shows symmetrical bell towers with low domes, stepped moldings and pinnacles, the entrance arcade, a gabled center with an oculus and the wide approach stair. Published church history describes 25 m towers.
